BiblicalUsage: The word is deceit, fraud, and it runs from the first family to the last Servant. Jacob came with subtlety and took his brother's blessing, the sons of Jacob answered Shechem with deceit, and the Proverbs say the counsels of the wicked are deceit — yet of the suffering Servant it is written that there was no deceit in His mouth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe deceit is the old family sin, and Christ is the end of it. He took no blessing by a trick, and the mouth that never deceived is the mouth that speaks for us.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
